title: Verification Engineer - Networking IPs
text:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are seeking enthusiastic, driven, and imaginative individuals to join our networking group. As the owner of networking IP's unit and cluster level verification, you will contribute to projects crafting the future of our datacenter chips and systems. You will gain direct experience of chip working with high-performance queuing and scheduling sub-systems.
 
What you'll be doing:
You will develop verification components and API's for unit and cluster level test benches. These will verify queuing and scheduling algorithms and designs.
During the course of a project, you will drive the following aspects of verification for your unit:
Architect the testbenches and craft verification environment using Specman language and methodology
Define test plans, tests and verification infrastructure for clusters and systems
Build efficient and reusable bus functional models, monitors, checkers, and scoreboards
Implement functional coverage and own unit/cluster level verification closure
Work with architects, designers, FPGA, and post-silicon teams to ensure that your unit is robust

What we need to see:
BTech or MTech in ECE, EE, CSE, or an equivalent degree is required. Candidates should have over 3 years of experience in verification closure of complex units, sub-systems, or SOC level verification.
Proven experience in networking specific Datapath and Switching verification IP's.
Experience in the latest verification methodologies like SV and UVM would be beneficial
Good debugging and analytical skills with exposure to industry-standard verification tools for simulation and debug
Good interpersonal skills, ability to work as a diligent teammate, and excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-cultural global teams and work in a matrix organization

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Exposure on using AI (like Claude or Cursor) extensively for code development would be a big plus
A mentality towards constant improvement and looking to build a multiplier effect through your work and automation
Exposure to Formal verification would be excellent

We have some of the most experienced and dedicated people in the world working at NVIDIA. If you're creative and independent, with a genuine passion for adopting newest technology, we want to hear from you. Join us and be part of something outstanding!

title: Security Engineer III - Infra Security
text:
About the Team
 
The security team at Meesho is like the Avengers to Meesho's S.H.I.E.L.D. After all, when 5% of Indian households shop with us, it’s important to build resilient systems to manage millions of orders every day. We’ve done this – with zero downtime! 😎 Sounds impossible? Well, that’s the kind of Engineering muscle that has helped Meesho become the e-commerce giant it is today. We value speed over perfection, and see failures as opportunities to become better. We’ve taken steps to inculcate a strong ‘Founder’s Mindset’ across our engineering teams, making us grow and move fast. We place special emphasis on the continuous growth of each team member - and we do this with regular 1-1s and open communication. As a Security Engineer, you will be part of self-starters who thrive on teamwork and constructive feedback. We know how to party as hard as we work! If we aren’t building unparalleled tech solutions, you can find us debating the plot points of our favorite books and games – or even gossiping over chai. So, if a day filled with building impactful solutions with a fun team sounds appealing to you, join us.
 
About the Role
 
As a Security Engineer 3 in Infrastructure Security, you are a senior individual contributor who owns Meesho's infrastructure security and security operations (SOC) end to end. You will be one of the engineers securing everything from GCP organisation policy and IAM down to Kubernetes workloads and CI/CD infrastructure, so you will set the technical direction for infrastructure security, not just execute it. You operate with limited supervision, act as the trusted security voice in infrastructure and platform architecture discussions, and partner closely with other engineers whom you will mentor and uplevel. 
The role rewards breadth with depth: you should be comfortable moving between cloud architecture reviews, hands-on hardening, detection engineering, and incident response in the same week, and you will have unusual freedom to automate, consolidate, and build the guardrails that let a lean team secure a platform operating at Meesho's scale.



What you will do
Cloud Security Architecture & Design Review: Own secure design for Meesho's GCP estate, including organisation policies, project structure, IAM and service-account hygiene, VPC design, VPC Service Controls, workload identity, and encryption/key management (Cloud KMS). Lead threat modeling and security reviews for new infrastructure and platform services, and drive the resulting requirements into production with platform engineering.

Kubernetes & Container Security: Harden GKE clusters and containerised workloads end to end: cluster configuration, RBAC, network policies, admission control and policy-as-code, workload identity, image provenance and registry controls, and runtime posture. Define the secure-by-default patterns that platform and product teams build on.

Identity & Zero Trust: Drive Meesho's zero-trust roadmap for infrastructure: least-privilege IAM at scale, elimination of long-lived credentials and static keys, just-in-time and break-glass access patterns, secrets management, and strong isolation between production and non-production environments.

Posture Management & Hardening: Own cloud security posture management using GCP-native tooling (Security Command Center) and complementary controls. Continuously find, prioritise, and burn down misconfigurations and attack paths across the estate, and convert recurring findings into preventive guardrails rather than tickets.

Infrastructure as Code & Pipeline Security: Embed security into how infrastructure ships: IaC scanning and policy enforcement (Terraform), CI/CD pipeline hardening, artifact and dependency integrity, and software supply-chain controls for infrastructure components.

SOC & Detection and Response (End-to-End Ownership): Own Meesho's SOC and detection & response function: run the SIEM and the managed detection (MxDR) partner relationship, own alert triage q

title: Product Engineer - Remote
text:
Overview
Find the problem. Decide what to build. Ship it to production and prove it worked.
Reporting to the CTO.
Company Details
Periskope helps businesses run customer conversations and operations on WhatsApp. Chats, groups, ticketing and automation live in one workspace, used by teams around the world.

$2.5M+ ARR

~12 People

Profitable · Global customers

Seed · Saison Capital and Alliance

Requirements

2–5 years: In engineering, product, a founder's office, or your own startup.

Product intuition: You can look at a screen and say what is wrong with it, and why.

Proof you build: Something real you made with AI tools. A product, an internal tool, an automation people still use.

Hustle: You unblock yourself. You do not wait for a spec, a designer or permission.

Appetite for depth: You do not need to know production systems today. You need to want to own them.

Clear communication: You explain decisions, flag uncertainty early, and move work forward in a remote team.

Responsibilities

Customer problems: Talk to users every week. Turn what you hear into a clear call on what to build next.

Concept to production: Scope it, build it with agents, deploy it, and iterate on real usage.

A product surface: Own a part of Periskope end to end, and the metric it moves.

What ships: Challenge agent output, test assumptions, and stay accountable for the code and the result.

Production reliability: When something breaks, find out why and fix it. Learn the data models, APIs and WhatsApp infrastructure underneath.

Job Details
Remote for candidates based in India.
Interview Process
Share your profile and one thing you took from idea to shipped: the problem, what you built, how you used agents, and what changed. Shortlisted candidates move through three steps.

Conversation · Async on WhatsApp
Talk through your work and product decisions with Bharat (CTO).

Build together · 90 minutes
Take a real Periskope problem from brief to working build, live with Bharat.

Final conversation · 20 minutes
Discuss the role and mutual fit with Swapnika (CEO).

Why This Role Exists
For years, building software needed two people. A PM decided what to build. An engineer wrote the code. Most of the time went into the handoff between them.
That split no longer makes sense. AI agents now write most of our code. Typing code stopped being the bottleneck. Judgment took its place: knowing which problem matters, what the smallest useful fix is, and whether it holds up in production.
A Product Engineer is one person doing the whole loop. You talk to the customer, make the call, direct the agents, ship the change and watch what happens next.
How the Work Flows

Listen: Sales calls, support chats, churn reasons, usage data.

Decide: Pick the problem that matters. Cut it to the smallest useful fix.

Build: Direct agents. Review every diff. Test what they assume.

Ship: Release to real customers, behind a flag if it is risky.

Measure: Check usage and tickets. Keep it, fix it or kill it.

Then back to listening. A good loop takes days, not quarters.
Who This Is For
You do not need an engineering title. You need taste, speed, and a real wish to build things that run in production.

Engineers: Who care more about the customer than the stack.

Product managers: Who are tired of writing specs for someone else to build.

Founder's office operators: Who already do a bit of everything and want to ship software too.

Ex-founders: Who want to build product again, with less overhead.

Not a Fit If

You want a defined lane. This role does not have one.

You see building as someone else's job.

You think agents ship production code on their own. They do not. You own every line they write.

Important Note
ClanX is a recruitment partner, helping Periskope hire a Product Engineer.
Highlights
Talk to users. Ship with agents. Own the outcome.

title: Join Our Non-Engineering Talent Network
text:
About the company

Trust Wallet is the secure, self-custody Web3 wallet that empowers people to own and control their digital assets. Whether you're new to crypto or an experienced user, Trust Wallet makes it easier, safer, and more convenient to explore Web3, securely access dApps, manage your crypto, and buy and sell digital assets, all in one place.

Trust Wallet: Future Opportunities (Non-Engineering)

Why This Role Exists

At Trust Wallet, we believe exceptional talent creates exceptional outcomes.

While most companies hire only when a specific position opens up, we take a longer-term view. We’re always looking to connect with outstanding people in product, marketing, partnerships and operations who can raise the bar, bring fresh perspectives, and help us serve hundreds of millions of users worldwide.

Not every great candidate fits neatly into an open job description, and not every future opportunity exists today.

This posting is for people who are excited about our mission but don’t see a perfect match among our current openings. If you believe you can make a meaningful impact at Trust Wallet, we’d love to hear from you.

We hire for potential, not just open headcount.

Future Non-Engineering Opportunities

As Trust Wallet continues to grow, we regularly open roles across:

Product & Design

 - Product Manager

 - Product Designer

 - Graphic & Motion Designer

Marketing & Growth

 - Product Marketing Manager

 - Social Media Manager

 - Community Manager

 - Public Relations Manager

Business Development & Partnerships

 - Business Development Manager

Operations & Customer Experience

 - Customer Support Officer

 - Operations Lead

Corporate Functions

 - People & Talent Acquisition

 - Legal, Risk & Compliance

If your experience aligns with any of these areas, or if you believe you can contribute in ways we haven’t yet imagined, we encourage you to apply.


What We’re Looking For

Every application is reviewed individually, but we’re especially excited to hear from people who:

 - Take strong ownership and deliver measurable results

 - Turn complex problems into clear, simple solutions

 - Use data to make decisions and test ideas

 - Communicate clearly and collaborate well across a globally distributed team

 - Are curious about Web3, AI and emerging technologies

 - Keep learning and improving

Web3 experience is welcome but not required for many positions.


What to Include in Your Application

To help us identify the right opportunity, please share:

 - Your preferred function or area

 - Your strongest skills and key achievements, with numbers where possible

 - Your current location and time zone

 - Links to your LinkedIn, portfolio, writing samples, campaigns or projects (if applicable)




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

This is a global and fully remote role. You must have the right to work for the country you are based.




WHY WORK AT TRUST WALLET?

 - Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow.

 - Excellent learning and career development opportunities.

 - Work alongside diverse, world-class talent, in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless.

 - Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects.

 - Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure.

 - Work fully remotely with flexible working hours.

 - Enjoy competitive salary and benefits.

Apply today to join our team in building the world’s most trusted and secure crypto wallet and enable a decentralized future for everyone.

Trust Wallet is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.



*Due to the large amount of the applications, please consider your application as unsuccessful should you not be contacted within 4 weeks from your application date.

Basic Requirements
Required Skills & Experience:
3- 8 years of Deep hands-on experience in Golang (preferred) and proficiency in C, C++, or Java.
